title: Kathy G Possible NDE 4743
content: After being in labor for nineteen hours my baby was stuck and the doctor decided to do an emergency cesarean section. When they were ready to cut, the epidural wasn't working anymore so they put me under anesthesia. I found myself in a very bright hallway, very beautiful and very cozy. At the end of the hallway, there were some figures, which I couldn't make out clearly. They were calling me by my first name and asking me to live, telling me that it was time, I had to go. At the same time, someone was slapping me in the face, calling me by my last name and asking me to wake up. I am not sure how long it lasted but it was a bit scary - especially that when I tried to talk about it on the floor, I was told that it was a hallucination.
